About

I am an AI engineer and researcher working on large language models. I build LLM-based agents at CodePresso and am pursuing an M.Sc. in Computer Science at Ton Duc Thang University.

My research focuses on adapting LLMs to specialised, low-resource settings: retrieval-augmented generation over legal documents, parameter-efficient fine-tuning for domain-specific question answering, and persona-driven synthetic data for imbalanced tasks such as depression screening (SOICT 2025). In industry, I work on agents for assessment content generation, automated code scoring and code-interview analysis, and on lowering serving cost with open-source models.

I also coach Ton Duc Thang University’s teams for the Vietnam Student AI Olympiad.
